# UPchieve Changelog, week of Jul 19 to 25, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Jul 24, subway Jul 24. These deploys carried the backlog that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review, so much of what follows is last week's pipeline reaching production.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## Student → Volunteer (S2V)

Lets a student become a volunteer coach on the same account, switching modes instead of creating a second one, so they can earn verified volunteer service hours.

- 🚀 **First-time coaches get a "Building your coach experience" transition screen.** The first time a student adds volunteer mode, a short celebratory screen plays before the volunteer dashboard, reinforcing that the account now has two modes to toggle between. Later switches keep using the existing toggle. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the avatar does not shake or spin and the content does not fade in, it just swaps. ([high-line !1777](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1777)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Volunteer hours page:** the impact summary pulled into its own component ([high-line !1783](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1783)); the hours calculator pulled into its own component ([high-line !1780](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1780)); the page now composes itself from the roles on the account instead of a feature flag, showing the impact summary to anyone with a coach role, the calculator to student-coaches, and the become-a-coach ad only to students who have not added coach mode yet ([high-line !1784](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1784)). *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Removed the `/add-volunteer-role` route and its `volunteer-ask-for-college-interest` flag.** It was an early path that added the volunteer role to students the flag targeted; the flag had been switched off. ([high-line !1782](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1782)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Emit one backend event when the volunteer role is added.** The several S2V entry points each fired their own event; they now fold into a single PostHog action, recorded server-side at the moment the role is added to the account. ([subway !2812](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2812)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🎁 **Drop "Account" from the role label in the avatar menu.** It now reads Student, Coach, Teacher, or Coach Ambassador. Teacher had no mapping and fell through to Student, and the ambassador label changed from "Volunteer Ambassador" to "Coach Ambassador". ([high-line !1760](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1760)) *Macy Lam*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Coach occupation on the user profile:** the occupation field added to the profile in read and edit modes ([high-line !1781](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1781)); PostHog events fired when a coach edits it ([high-line !1786](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1786)); the backend to update occupation from the profile ([subway !2811](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2811)); a primary key on `volunteer_occupations` so its row deletes replicate ([subway !2813](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2813)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- **Surveys without wired-up response choices:** 🚀 free-response questions return without a placeholder response choice ([subway !2815](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2815)); 🚀 free-response submissions save without choice IDs ([subway !2814](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2814)); 🚀 the front end supports choice-less free-response questions ([high-line !1787](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1787)); 🚀 a topic name can be substituted into question text, not just a subject name ([subway !2816](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2816)); 👀 the front end learns which new questions can appear under each section ([high-line !1791](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1791)). *Trey Stevens*
- 🧪 **Stop high school student coaches from picking up college-topic sessions.** College sessions drop out of their open-sessions list, they get no new-session notification for one, and the hourly job that caches textable coaches now carries occupation so the texting job can skip them too. Whether high school students should coach college topics is an open debate, so it sits behind a flag while the team studies the impact. Rolled out to 25% of approved, onboarded high school student coaches who have been active since July 1. ([`hs-students-barred-from-coaching-college-subjects`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/775834)) ([high-line !1789](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1789), [subway !2818](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2818)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- **Screen image uploads with PhotoDNA before they are stored.** [#658](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/658): ✅ session photos upload through the backend ([subway !2757](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2757)); ✅ the front end sends volunteer photo IDs to the backend ([high-line !1711](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1711)); 👀 the backend receives them ([subway !2758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2758)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Load private schools so a coach who does not attend a public school still gets a school on their account.** A new job upserts the NCES private-school survey dataset alongside the existing public-school upsert. It uses the 2021 to 2022 data, since the 2023 to 2024 release is late. ([subway !2820](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2820)) *Kasozi Wilson*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Show a validation error when the coach background form's country or state is empty.** Both fields were required, but neither input was marked required, so the field silently cleared itself and Submit stayed greyed out with nothing explaining why. 🐛 [#675](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/675) ([high-line !1788](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1788)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Stop dropping student completion data.** A shared `makeSomeOptional` helper strips null fields, so a later `submitted_at === null` check silently failed: the field was now undefined, and undefined is not null. The comparison was corrected and consolidated into one place. ([high-line !1785](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1785)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Filter cached students instead of refetching on every teacher filter change.** The teacher student-details tab re-ran the full students-and-session-details fetch on each filter change; it now fetches once on load and filters a cached, computed view. ([high-line !1778](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1778)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Date the "Nationally Certified Tutor" certificate from the volunteer's first session.** The certificate always showed the day it was downloaded. It was meant to show when the volunteer passed the last of their onboarding certs, but the code read `lastAttemptedAt` off the wrong object, got undefined, and `dayjs(undefined)` returns today. The first session date is the better date anyway, since that is when the volunteer started providing value. 🐛 [#672](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/672) ([subway !2819](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2819); [high-line !1790](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1790)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Give ClassLink teachers their classes.** Class rostering was wired only into the Clever SSO login path and pulled data with the teacher's Clever login token, which a ClassLink login never produces, so a ClassLink teacher got an account and no classes. Teachers and their classes now roster from the admin Clever district roster using the district access token, and login-time rostering is gone, so SSO is pure identity: a teacher signing in through any provider is matched to the account they were already rostered into. ([subway !2748](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2748)) *Chris*
- 👀 **Catch it when Clever changes a field we depend on.** The roster logic is unit-tested with Clever mocked, so nothing tells us whether the live API still returns the fields and shapes we read. A thin contract test now validates the real sandbox district's response with zod. It introduces integration tests as a category, like the database tests but for third-party integrations: they run only when asked for, through Doppler against staging, because they are slow and need live credentials. ([subway !2765](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2765)) *Chris*

### Internal tools

- 🚀 **Admin users table:** a column header row (USER ID, CREATED AT, NAME, EMAIL, ROLES), roles shown capitalized and comma-separated, long emails wrapped to two lines instead of overlapping adjacent columns, tighter row padding with a bottom border, and pagination below the table ([high-line !1715](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1715)); user search returns every role on the account instead of one legacy role ([subway !2764](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2764)); results sorted by most recent activity first ([subway !2763](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2763)). *Macy Lam*
